description: This file defines custom attributes for marking classes as implicit stream subscriptions in Orleans, including handling of stream namespace predicates and binding generation.

classes.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to mark grains for implicit stream subscriptions with various predicate options and binding generation.

classes.name: RegexImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute
classes.description: Sealed attribute class for regex-based implicit stream subscriptions, inheriting from ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute.

methods.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute()
methods.description: Default constructor subscribing to all stream namespaces.

methods.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute(string streamNamespace, string channelIdMapper = null)
methods.description: Constructor for subscribing to a specific stream namespace with optional channel ID mapper.

methods.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute(Type predicateType, string channelIdMapper = null)
methods.description: Constructor accepting a predicate type to filter stream namespaces.

methods.name: ImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute(IChannelNamespacePredicate predicate, string channelIdMapper = null)
methods.description: Constructor accepting an existing predicate instance.

methods.name: GetBindings(IServiceProvider services, Type grainClass, GrainType grainType)
methods.description: Generates binding dictionary for the grain based on its class and type, including legacy key type handling.

methods.name: RegexImplicitChannelSubscriptionAttribute([StringSyntax(StringSyntaxAttribute.Regex)] string pattern)
methods.description: Constructor for regex-based stream namespace filtering.
